description: Source file defining command-line interface commands for microphone management, including listing devices and setting the default input device.

classes.name: MicCommand
classes.description: Defines the main command group for microphone management with subcommands for listing and setting devices.

classes.name: MicList
classes.description: Implements the command to list available microphone input devices.

classes.name: MicSet
classes.description: Implements the command to set the default microphone input device by index, with optional configuration path.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the command's main action, either listing devices or updating configuration based on input.
